sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Giona is an Irish hero of the Fianna. He was the grandson of Fionn Mac Cumhaill. A lazy fellow, Giona struggled to command his warriors, who saw him as a weak chief. Fionn took him under his care and shaped him into a great Fenian hero.

okr.objective: Document Giona as a Fianna hero shaped by his grandfather.
